nodes.title: SG-1.4.1 · Create the HeaderOverlay component wired to the UI store
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend has no HeaderOverlay yet. App.tsx renders RoundBadge (which shows a bare 'Round unavailable' on failure) and Countdown directly. Desired behavior: a HeaderOverlay component takes props worldTitle, round, loading and error and shows the logo, world name, round ID, status, countdown, sound toggle and settings button, wired to useUiStore, with loading, empty and error states that explain a round API failure. Expected result: a tested, standalone component. Why: the compact header and honest round-failure messaging are required by the StoryForge redesign.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a round, When HeaderOverlay renders, Then logo, world title, round ID, status, countdown, sound toggle and settings button are visible
- Given the sound toggle and settings button are clicked, When the store is read, Then soundEnabled and settingsOpen have flipped
- Given loading, no round, or an error, When HeaderOverlay renders, Then a loading, empty or error message is shown, and the error message explains the failure


## Scope
- In scope: New HeaderOverlay.tsx in game/frontend/src/components
- In scope: Use of existing useUiStore, Countdown and lucide-react icons
- Out of scope: Composing HeaderOverlay into App or GameLayout
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Changing uiStore
- Preserve: Existing Countdown and RoundBadge behavior and tests
- Preserve: uiStore state shape and actions
- Preserve: API client contracts


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript + Tailwind classes; lucide-react icons; Button from components/ui/button
- State read via useUiStore selectors from src/store/uiStore.ts
- Round type comes from src/api/client.ts


## Definition of done
- HeaderOverlay exported from game/frontend/src/components/HeaderOverlay.tsx
- All requirement Verify units pass


## Non-functional requirements
- Accessible names on icon buttons


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · HeaderOverlay shows logo, world name, round ID, status and countdown
nodes.body:
Context: round data is a Round from api/client.ts (id, number, status, starts_at, ends_at). Desired behavior: with a round supplied, the header shows the StoryForge logo, worldTitle, round.id, round.status and a Countdown to round.ends_at. Expected result: all five items present in one compact bar. Why: players must see which round is live and when it ends.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given worldTitle 'The Boy's Room' and a round, When rendered, Then the text 'StoryForge', the world title, round.id and round.status are in the document
- Given a round with a future ends_at, When rendered, Then a role=timer element is present


## Scope
- In scope: Logo, world name, round ID, status, countdown rendering
- Out of scope: Sound and settings controls
- Out of scope: Loading/error states
- Preserve: Countdown component API


## Technical constraints
- Reuse Countdown from components/Countdown.tsx


## Definition of done
- Round info renders from props


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · HeaderOverlay sound toggle and settings are wired to useUiStore
nodes.body:
Context: uiStore exposes soundEnabled, settingsOpen, toggleSound and toggleSettings. Desired behavior: HeaderOverlay shows a sound button whose icon and aria-pressed reflect soundEnabled and calls toggleSound on click, and a settings button that calls toggleSettings. Expected result: clicking changes store state. Why: header controls must drive shared UI state, not local state.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given soundEnabled true, When the 'Toggle sound' button is clicked, Then store soundEnabled is false and aria-pressed reflects the state
- Given settingsOpen false, When the 'Settings' button is clicked, Then store settingsOpen is true


## Scope
- In scope: Sound and settings buttons in HeaderOverlay
- Out of scope: Settings panel content
- Out of scope: Audio playback
- Preserve: uiStore shape


## Technical constraints
- Use useUiStore selectors; lucide Volume2, VolumeX, Settings icons


## Definition of done
- Controls wired to the real store


## Non-functional requirements
- aria-label on each icon button


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · HeaderOverlay has loading, empty and error states explaining round API failure
nodes.body:
Context: RoundBadge currently shows 'Round unavailable' with no reason. Desired behavior: loading=true shows 'Loading round…'; error set shows 'Round unavailable: <error>' in role=alert; no round, no error and not loading shows 'No active round'. Logo, world name and controls stay visible in all states. Expected result: failure is explained. Why: users must understand why no round is shown.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given loading true, When rendered, Then 'Loading round…' is shown and no timer is present
- Given error 'Round service returned 500', When rendered, Then a role=alert contains that text
- Given loading false, error undefined, round undefined, When rendered, Then 'No active round' is shown


## Scope
- In scope: Three non-ready states and their precedence: error over loading over empty
- Out of scope: Fetching the round
- Out of scope: Retry button
- Preserve: Logo and controls visible in all states


## Technical constraints
- error prop is string | undefined


## Definition of done
- All three states render distinct text


## Non-functional requirements
- Error uses role=alert


## Clarifying questions
- None
